svg.aria-label: The same cross-section of an underground mine with the proposed approach in place: one shared record joins the planner, the ventilation room, the sampler and the fan house, the main fan runs slower, air is thick toward the active heading and thin to idle ones, level sensors feed a model that matches the airways, the blast gas has cleared and crews go back on a green light, the face is cooler, a battery loader leaves a smaller exhaust cloud and the energy meter is lower
svg.title: The proposal: air follows the work, from one shared record
